note: modal_p = the excess probability a cell shows its class's modal level (0 = indistinguishable classes). The floor is the WEAKEST separation the LCM recovers k*>=2 in >=80% of seeds at canon n + missingness. k*=1 on the canon => any real latent structure sits below this detectable-effect floor; recovery falling to ~0 by modal_p=0 confirms the estimator is not trivially always-detecting.
